title: hYYa Footprint Inspector
shortDescription: Bona okwaziwa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukulungise. Kumahhala futhi kuyimfihlo.
fullDescription:
Izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza zingazi okuningi kakhulu ngawe kunalokho okucabangayo. I-hYYa Footprint Inspector ikukhombisa ngamagama alula lokho ezingakubona, abangakubuka, nokuthi ungalungisa kanjani konke lokhu.

IZINYATHELO EZINE EZILULA
1. Umkhondo wedijithali (footprint): ukuthinta kanye nje kuhlola lokho noma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza olungakufunda mayelana nedivayisi yakho bese kukunika amaphuzu kumbe isikolo kwikhulu (100). Amaphuzu aphezulu angcono kakhulu.
2. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibucayi: bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zakho zokusebenza abanye abangazibona, njengezokuqomisana, ezokholo, ezempilo noma izinhlelo ze-VPN, nokuthi lokho kungadalulani ngawe.
3. Izilandeleli (trackers): bona ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingafunda isikrini sakho, zifunde zonke izaziso, noma zikwazi ukukhiya idivayisi yakho. Izinhlelo ezinamalungelo angaphezu kwelilodwa kulawa ziyaphawulwa, ngoba yindlela izinhlelo zokubheka ezisebenza ngayo. Bese uvula irekhodi le-Android uqobo elibonisa ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezisebenzise indawo yakho, ikhamera kanye nombhobho.
4. Ukuhlola ubumfihlo (privacy check): hamba kuzilungiselelo zakho (Settings) ingxenye eyodwa ngesikhathi, ubuyise izimvume zohlelo lokusebenza (app permissions) ongafuni ukuzinikeza abanye.

LUNGISA NAMI
Thinta okuthi "Lungisa nami" bese lolu hlelo lokusebenza lukuhambisa kulungiso ngalunye, luqondise ngqo kusilungiselelo esifanele ku-Settings. Bese uhlola kabusha ukuze ubone amaphuzu akho enyuka.

KUCACILE, KUZOLILE FUTHI KUTHEMBEKILE
• Ishadi lemibala ekhasini ngalinye: okubomvu kumele kubhekwe, okuwolintshi kufanele ukwazi, okuluhlaza kulungile.
• Konke okutholiwe kuyachazwa: ukuthi kudalulani, kubucayi kangakanani nokuthi kuhlala isikhathi esingakanani.
• Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezakhelwe ngaphakathi kudivayisi yakho aziphawulwa kabi, kanti izinhlelo zokulawula zabazali noma ezomsebenzi zibizwa ngalokho eziyikho ngempela.
• Ukwethembeka kokuthi "yi-Google kuphela noma umenzi wedivayisi ongakulungisa lokhu" uma kungekho ongakwenza.
• Isikhumbuzi samasonto onke noma senyanga sokuhlola kabusha, uma usifuna.

UKUBONAKALA NOMA USULUSUSILE UHLELO LOKUSEBENZA
I-Android inika izinhlelo zenkampani ngayinye ikhodi ehlala ifana noma ngabe uyalisusa bese ulifaka kabusha. Bona i-device fingerprint yakho, nokuthi kungani ukusetha kabusha kwasefekthri kuphela okuyishintshayo.

UBUMFIHLO NGOKWAKHIWA KWAYO
• Ayikho imvume ye-inthanethi: lolu hlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuxhuma ndawo, ngakho-ke akukho lutho oluphuma kudivayisi yakho.
• Ayikho i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela.
• Kumahhala. Akukho okuthengwayo, akukho okubhaliselwayo.
• Insimbi evulekile (open source, Mozilla Public License 2.0), ukuze noma ubani akwazi ukuhlola ukuthi isebenza kanjani.

Hlangana nomphenyi: usesikrinini ngasinye futhi unamacebiso amahle uma umthinta.

I-hYYa Footprint Inspector iyingxenye yomndeni we-hYYa wezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibeka ubumfihlo kuqala.
